# External Reference Datasets

No external datasets were used in this project. The assigned dataset (MNIST) was sufficient on its own, and is expected to be sufficient for the full modeling pipeline.
If an external reference dataset is introduced later (e.g. a real handwritten-mail sample set for testing
generalization beyond MNIST, per the "Limitations & Mitigation" plan in the proposal), it will be added here
along with its source and citation.
